headline: Safaricom Half-Year Profit Rises 36% on M-Pesa Growth
summary: Kenyan telecommunications firm Safaricom reported a 35.9% increase in net profit to Sh58.2 billion for the six months ending September. Growth was driven by higher M-Pesa revenue and expansion in Ethiopia.
why: Safaricom is the largest company on the Nairobi Securities Exchange and a bellwether for the East African tech and telecom sector.
